scope: Original formal 600-cohort task manifest and its 120 clean episodes only; retry campaign excluded

method.feature_extraction: Static AST of pinned source ground_truth methods; every literal FunctionCall count agrees with frozen offline execution count. No task execution, model inference, Pydantic environment reconstruction, or score changes.
method.task_unit: 60 distinct (suite,user_task_id) clusters; two correlated seed episodes per task
method.task_intent: information_answer versus explicit_action from reference write tools; information retrieval may have technical state effects, recorded separately
method.reference_length: Executed ground-truth call count from manifest, cross-checked with source; one benchmark reference path, not minimum required calls or inherent task difficulty
method.tool_sequence: FunctionCall literals in ground_truth source-line order, matching known executed count, not a freshly replayed trace
method.prompt_length: Whitespace-delimited words and Unicode characters in legitimate user prompt, not model tokens or full context
method.context_length: Observed returned-response usage.prompt_tokens, including system/user/history/tool schema/chat formatting; failed request token counts unknown. Maximum returned context is a lower bound where a request failed.
method.context_causality: Maximum history and repeated calls are outcomes of model behavior; a failure may cause longer context. First context includes suite-specific schema and is confounded with suite.
method.repeat_measure: Exact same accepted function+canonical args after first occurrence; repeats are mechanical observations, not automatically pathological loops
method.action_omission_measure: Reference includes an explicit action tool, while actual accepted tool results contain none of the manually enumerated write/send/update/delete functions. Tool calls that return errors still count as attempts; absence is descriptive and is not a model-internal cause.
method.family_grouping: reference_tool_family_overlapping groups overlap; a multi-family task appears in each applicable family and totals must not be added
method.bin_selection: Fixed coarse thresholds before computing group rates, after original experiment; exploratory and not preregistered
method.statistics: Descriptive counts/rates and medians; no significance tests, classifier fitting, bootstrap, or independent-episode claims
method.review_labels: Existing complete-clean agent trace annotations, qualitative rather than independent human/validated judge labels
method.scores: Official Boolean/None utility retained; checker limitations apply, especially Workspace task27 false-positive semantics and Travel task3 final-turn-only text checks

limitations: Task selection is fixed and non-random; 60 tasks and only two seeds limit generalization.
Suite, task intent, source difficulty, reference length and schema/context length strongly overlap; pooled patterns are not isolated causal effects.
Task family groups are hand-defined domains of the benchmark reference tools, not a validated universal taxonomy.
No clean reference-path context token lengths exist in the frozen audit; do not use observed model histories as independent task complexity.
Official success does not imply every semantic requirement is satisfied; official false can include extra side effects or final-turn answer omissions.
Original 120 clean outcomes are not 120 independent tasks. Unknown outcomes are neither success nor a known failure.
